claim: The in-app dashboard (the knob that pulls down from the top) renders REAL identity-health metrics — contamination, coherence, growth gauges + the pre-registered verdict — sourced from the live metrics, not placeholder numbers.
owner: anima/metrics.py (summary/verdict), anima/server.py (GET /metrics — gated on env ANIMA_METRICS=1, else 404), anima/web/index.html (#dashknob/#dash, openDash -> GET /metrics, gauges + verdict), anima/growth.py, scripts/growth_dashboard.py

killer_test.name: dashboard_renders_real_metrics_when_enabled
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store seeded with a known metrics ledger (contamination/coherence/growth rows). With ANIMA_METRICS unset, GET /metrics returns 404 (dashboard shows the 'start with ANIMA_METRICS=1' hint — honest, not fake gauges). With ANIMA_METRICS=1, GET /metrics returns metrics.summary(name) + metrics.verdict(name); assert the returned gauge values EQUAL the seeded ledger (organic_break_rate, narrative_accept_rate, consolidations-kept, median prediction delta) and the verdict string is the real verdict — i.e. the UI numbers trace to real data, not constants. Real .anima byte-unchanged.
killer_test.prompt: (operator action: open the dashboard knob -> GET /metrics)

known_gaps: GET /metrics is 404 unless the server was started with ANIMA_METRICS=1 — so the dashboard is OFF by default and the UI correctly shows a hint instead of gauges. The cert must verify the enabled path returns REAL ledger-derived numbers (the wallpaper risk here is gauges that render but are constant/zero regardless of the ledger).
Do NOT start the live server or set ANIMA_METRICS against the real .anima for this; exercise metrics.summary/verdict + the /metrics handler in-process against a temp store.
